subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Prove the draft process end to end from a fresh clone before release (DOD-4), keep draft content unchanged when a step fails (UB-9), and fix defects forward as the top priority.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The switch-over has no pilot and no way back (NG-6), so a draft-process defect would stop all new feature contracting. The end-to-end proof finds defects before release, and UB-9 keeps any later failure from losing draft content.
fit_criterion: The DOD-4 run passes from a fresh clone before release, and injected failures at each step leave draft content byte-identical and name the failing step.
